title: On Communicating the order to every boat
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：communicate　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 communicate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the builder ① communicated the order to every boat twice over, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② communicates the order to every boat year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ communicate the order to every boat at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ communicated the order to every boat before — a line in the plan for October 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Communicating the order to every boat twice over, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ communicate without a single written word year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Communicate without a single written word at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ communicates without a single written word twice over every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ communicated the order to every boat again when nobody else would.

⑩ To communicate the order to every boat, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody communicates the order to every boat year after year again and somebody must communicate the order to every boat twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 传达（一般过去式 communicated the order to every boat：1957 年施工员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 传达（一般现在 communicates the order to every boat：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 传达（不定式 to communicate the order to every boat：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 传达（过去完成时 had communicated the order to every boat：1951 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 传达（动名词 communicating the order to every boat 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 沟通（communicate without a single written word：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去沟通一个字也不写就沟通下来）
G. v. 沟通（communicate without a single written word：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 传达（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 communicates without a single written word，而母亲又一次 communicated the order to every boat）

answers.why: communicate 意为“传达”，1957 年施工员来回两遍传达把命令传达到每一条船，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 communicated。
communicate 意为“传达”，自那以后施工员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 communicates。
communicate 意为“传达”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯传达把命令传达到每一条船”，此处为不定式 to communicate the order to every boat。
communicate 意为“传达”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人传达过，故用过去完成时 had communicated。
communicate 意为“传达”，施工员说“传达把命令传达到每一条船这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 communicating the order to every boat 作主语。
communicate 意为“沟通”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去沟通一个字也不写就沟通下来”，should ever 之后用原形 communicate without a single written word。
communicate 意为“沟通”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻沟通一个字也不写就沟通下来（communicate without a single written word at once），以后再也不要提起。
communicate 意为“传达”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例沟通一个字也不写就沟通下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 communicates。
communicate 意为“传达”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍传达把命令传达到每一条船，用一般过去式 communicated 叙述。
communicate 意为“传达”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要传达把命令传达到每一条船，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

items: 1957 年，施工员来回两遍传达把命令传达到每一条船；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（communicated the order to every boat）
多年以后，施工员仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（communicates the order to every boat）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯传达把命令传达到每一条船这件事本身。（to communicate the order to every boat）
早在 1951 年就有人传达把命令传达到每一条船，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had communicated the order to every boat）
施工员说过，来回两遍传达把命令传达到每一条船这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（communicating the order to every boat 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻沟通一个字也不写就沟通下来，以后再也不要提起。（communicate without a single written word，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the builder communicated the order to every boat twice over, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the builder still communicates the order to every boat year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to communicate the order to every boat at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had communicated the order to every boat long before 1964, and the line in the plan for October proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 communicate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the builder communicated the order to every boat twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder communicates the order to every boat year after year whenever the site asks.
Communicating the order to every boat twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever communicate without a single written word year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site communicates without a single written word twice over every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother communicated the order to every boat again, and the site remembered that half.
